notes.title: Wordatro | Release Date Trailer
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="t3y3-cEqkKQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Wordatro! is coming to Steam [b]on Monday, June 23, 2025 at 7 p.m. CET[/b]![/p][p]I'm both very happy and very scared that it's so soon... If you haven't already, please consider adding the game to your wishlist to help me gain more visibility.[/p][p]I'd also like to remind you that for every 1000 wishlists, I'm giving away a key to the game on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FfF8CXAYPMy"]Discord server[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3140120/Wordatro/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]For the occasion, I've made a major update to the game, with 7 playable languages instead of 2, and 9 languages available for the player interface![/p][p]You can now form words in [b]English, French[/b], [b]Spanish, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese,[/b] and [b]Dutch[/b]. The interface is available in all these languages, as well as in [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Russian[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]4 difficulty levels[/b] to test your language skills[/p][/*][*][p][b]50+ unique bonuses:[/b] Incredible upgrades and synergies to destroy score targets[/p][/*][*][p][b]50 creative challenges:[/b] put your skills to the test with a myriad of additional challenges.[/p][/*][/list][p]A new demo is available to give you a taste of the full game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45289346/b5af8ec7fe65b474c68402bd1a3ef7c2798d021e.png"][/img][/p][h1]Wordatro soundtrack![/h1][p]To coincide with the game's release, the Wordatro! soundtrack will also be available on Steam! Immerse yourself in the relaxing ambience that [b]Tiny Squid[/b] has composed for peaceful play.[/p][p]The soundtrack will include all 8 tracks featured in the game, for a total of over 20 minutes of music![/p][p][/p][h1]Accessibility[/h1][p]I'm working with Olivier Nourry (from Games Accessibility Hub), who joined me on the Wordatro! adventure to make the game accessible to as many people as possible. I'll tell you more about this when it's released, but here are a few points that reinforce Wordatro's accessibility:[/p][list][*][p]Some animated effects can be deactivated, and 3 speed levels are available to prevent kinetosis,[/p][/*][*][p]Color is not the only vector of information,[/p][/*][*][p]Large, self-explanatory icons,[/p][/*][*][p]Wordatro! can be played in windowed or full-screen mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Typographies chosen for their legibility[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]See you on Monday, 23rd. I can't wait![/p][p][/p][p]Le Poulet[/p]

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
- Added Twitch support for suggesting words and voting for bonuses.
- Game now saves when you quit mid-game (except for the daily challenge, no saves there).
- Two difficulty levels.

[h2]QoL[/h2]
- You can now skip the intro by clicking.
- Bonuses can be selected with the keyboard (using left/up/right arrow keys).
- Sorting letters now prioritizes letters with abilities.
- Added Steam usernames to the leaderboard.
- Added sounds/music.
- A few more FX for point scoring.

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
- The daily challenge is a bit harder.
- Yoyo bonus now increases based on differences in word length.
- You can no longer draw the same bonus twice in a row.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Tile bonuses no longer disappear when performing actions on them quickly.
- The screen no longer zooms out at the end of a game.
